result.instructions: Tools for Device Magic, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my forms and show the submissions of the Site Inspection form from last week."; "Which devices are waiting for approval?"; "Show the outstanding dispatches for the whole team.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Device Magic data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run devicemagic_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run devicemagic_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run devicemagic_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. devicemagic_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: devicemagic_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List the organization's forms: id, namespace (the form's unique id used for dispatching), version, description and group. GET /organizations/{org}/forms.json.

tools.name: devicemagic_get_form
tools.title: Get form definition
tools.description: One form's definition: title and its questions/pages with identifiers and types (the identifiers are the keys inside submissions and dispatch payloads). Optionally a specific version. GET /organizations/{org}/forms/{id}.json.

version.description: Form version such as 1.03; default = the latest.

tools.name: devicemagic_list_submissions
tools.title: List form submissions
tools.description: Submitted data of one form, newest data as stored in the form's Device Magic Database destination (it must be active on that form). Each record has form info, metadata (device, user, submitted_at, received_at, submission_id) and the answers. The reply says current_page, total_pages and total_count. Filter by from_date/to_date (yyyy-mm-dd). GET /api/forms/{id}/device_magic_database.json.

to_date.description: Only submissions up to this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (use total_pages from the reply).

tools.name: devicemagic_list_devices
tools.title: List devices
tools.description: List the organization's devices (phones, tablets, web-form users): id, identifier, owner, description, group and whether approval is pending. GET /organizations/{org}/devices.json.

tools.name: devicemagic_get_device
tools.title: Get device
tools.description: One device: id, identifier, owner, description, pending_approval, groups and custom attributes. GET /organizations/{org}/devices/{id}.json.

tools.name: devicemagic_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the organization's groups (which devices see which forms), optionally narrowed by a name filter or by tags. GET /api/v2/organizations/{org}/groups.json.

filter.description: Group name to look for, e.g. Default (the vendor matches part of the name).

tags.description: Only groups having any of these tags (the vendor matches any tag).

tools.name: devicemagic_list_resources
tools.title: List resources
tools.description: List the organization's resources (lookup tables and files used by forms): id, original filename, version, description. GET /api/resources.json.

tools.name: devicemagic_describe_resource
tools.title: Describe resource
tools.description: Metadata of one resource: status, version and, for spreadsheets, its tables and columns. The file content itself is not downloaded. GET /api/resources/{id}/describe.json.

tools.name: devicemagic_list_destinations
tools.title: List form destinations
tools.description: List where one form's submissions are sent (e-mail, Dropbox, database, ...): id, active flag, format and transport types, timestamps. GET /api/forms/{id}/destinations.json.

tools.name: devicemagic_get_destination
tools.title: Get form destination
tools.description: One destination of a form. Credentials and tokens of the destination are never returned. GET /api/forms/{form_id}/destinations/{id}.json.

tools.name: devicemagic_list_dispatches
tools.title: List outstanding dispatches
tools.description: Outstanding dispatches (prefilled forms pushed to devices and not yet completed) of the whole organization: id, form name and namespace, device, scheduled time. Dispatch is an Enterprise-plan feature. GET /api/v2/organizations/{org}/dispatches.json.

tools.name: devicemagic_list_device_dispatches
tools.title: List a device's outstanding dispatches
tools.description: Outstanding dispatches of one device. GET /api/v2/devices/{identifier}/dispatches.json.

device_identifier.description: Device identifier (field `identifier` of a device, e.g. iPhone_abcdef1234567890).

tools.name: devicemagic_get_dispatch
tools.title: Get dispatch with prefilled values
tools.description: One dispatch of a device including the values it was prefilled with. GET /api/v3/devices/{identifier}/dispatches/{id}.json?include_inputs=true.

device_identifier.description: Device identifier (field `identifier` of a device, e.g. iPhone_abcdef1234567890).

dispatch_id.description: Dispatch id (field `id` of a dispatch list).

tools.name: devicemagic_list_dispatch_recipients
tools.title: List dispatch recipients
tools.description: Devices and web-forms users a dispatch can be sent to (first 100 by default; use items and page for more). GET /api/v3/dispatch_authors.json.

tools.name: devicemagic_send_dispatch
tools.title: Send a form to a device (dispatch)
tools.description: WRITE: pushes a form, optionally prefilled, to one device where its user will see it (like assigning a job). Not idempotent: calling it twice sends two dispatches. Needs the Enterprise plan. The form is named by its namespace (list_forms); `payload` maps question identifiers (get_form) to prefilled values (subforms = nested objects, repeat groups = arrays). POST /api/v2/devices/{identifier}/dispatches.json.

device_identifier.description: Device identifier (field `identifier` of a device, e.g. iPhone_abcdef1234567890).

payload.description: Prefilled values keyed by question identifier.

form_name.description: Title shown to the device user.

form_description.description: Description shown to the device user (Device Magic allows at most 255 characters).

scheduled_at.description: When the dispatch becomes due, ISO 8601 such as 2026-11-02T09:00:00Z.

confirm.description: Must be true: you confirm the form is sent to this device now (its user sees it).

annotations.title: Send a form to a device (dispatch)

tools.name: devicemagic_revoke_dispatch
tools.title: Revoke a dispatch
tools.description: WRITE: withdraws one outstanding dispatch from a device (the form disappears from the device). It cannot be undone, but the dispatch can be sent again. DELETE /api/v2/devices/{identifier}/dispatches/{id}.json.

device_identifier.description: Device identifier (field `identifier` of a device, e.g. iPhone_abcdef1234567890).

confirm.description: Must be true: you confirm the dispatch is withdrawn from the device.

tools.name: devicemagic_approve_device
tools.title: Approve a pending device
tools.description: WRITE: approves a device that is waiting for approval (pending_approval is true) so it can receive forms. Approving an approved device has no effect. POST /organizations/{org}/devices/{id}/approve.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Device Magic
prompts.description: What you can do with Device Magic here, with example requests to try.
